5256-6277-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

574-2317-6763-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-2317-6763-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

206-4311-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6112-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6112-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

628-728-7191.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
3129-4094-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

348-1152-3191-6255-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-6255-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Zahur triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

1257-5233-7857.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

443-2946-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-2946-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-527-647.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-647.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-3291-4359.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-4359.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1742-2035-7422.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gollum, adding {B}.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

914-3335-4460.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3335-4460.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Lady Sun by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-3335-4460.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

4853-4917-5776-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
4853-4917-5776-6429.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4210-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4210-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3949-4030-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

2438-5220-6537-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

997-2173-3239-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

4484-4871-5643-6556-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5643-6556-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4484-4871-5643-6556-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5643-6556-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2292-4112-4375.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2882-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2292-2882-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2292-2882-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

1445-2279-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-3967-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2816-3621-4763-6068.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, targeting Koll.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2350-3705-5231-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2452-3249-5670-5931--56.notablePrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Your life total is at least 2.
2452-3249-5670-5931--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Funeral Room // Awakening Hall triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1778-4050-4871-5222.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Memnite.
1778-4050-4871-5222.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {1}.
When Memnite dies, Sword of the Realms and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Memnite to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Memnite.
Repeat.

2111-3466-4053.description:
Cast Wingrattle Scarecrow by paying {3}.
Wingrattle Scarecrow enters the battlefield, triggering Reaper King, destroying Wingrattle Scarecrow.
Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 3.

417-2018-2781-4050.description:
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Phyrexian Altar to add 1 mana of any color.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Felidar Guardian to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Felidar Guardian's ETB triggers, exiling Mystic Decree and then returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.
